items: Widgets now update by themselves, even when Amaviro is closed.
Now, Sports and Family show that pulling down refreshes them, and when they last did.
Server Health widgets check every address of your provider, not just the one in use.

description: Find the match. Fix the stream. Keep watching. Amaviro is a TV player for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV that finds the channel showing your game and sorts out what goes wrong, on the TV service you already pay for.
